name: Nokia SR Linux Container Image
description: Freely distributed official Nokia SR Linux container image. No registration, licensing, or contract required. Runs as a Docker container with full NETCONF, gNMI, and CLI management.
eval_notes: Production-grade NOS available as a free container. gNMI/YANG management makes it ideal for network automation evaluations. Primary target for containerlab labs. Containerlab auto-configures NETCONF server on port 830 with credentials admin:NokiaSrl1!. Full YANG coverage for streaming telemetry. Requires Linux kernel v4+, Docker, 2 vCPU and 4GB RAM minimum. Comprehensive documentation at learn.srlinux.dev. Free, no registration required. Pull from ghcr.io/nokia/srlinux. ~0.5 vCPU and ~1GB RAM per instance. Without license: 1000pps throughput limit and 2-week runtime limit. Best free NOS for learning and CI.
